Data and research design

50 Appendix A instruments · 4,321,070 raw contract-day observations · 346,218 feature rows

  • 1990–2020 target; vendor coverage differences disclosed
  • Same-contract returns, calendar rolls and causal settlement marks
  • Five main expanding OOS windows, plus a separate 2020 test
  • Per-instrument 90/10 chronological split; boundary labels purged

LSTM with online GP changepoint features

  • Original author return and MACD feature functions
  • Stationary Matérn 3/2 GP versus sigmoid changepoint GP
  • Daily CPD severity and location at 10/21/63/126/252 sessions
  • Stateless 63-step LSTM; tanh position and negative Sharpe loss
  • Validation selects hyperparameters and the CPD horizon

Conclusions and reproducibility

The mean five-window gross Sharpe is 1.815 for LSTM and 1.602 for the validation-selected CPD model (difference -0.212). The published figures are 1.62 and 2.16. The datasets, roll conventions and numerical backends differ, so their numerical difference is not an implementation error estimate.

At 2.5 one-way bps, original-style turnover-adjusted mean Sharpe is LSTM: 0.302, LSTM-CPD-Optimised: -0.377, TSMOM w=0: 0.940. This is a cost scenario, not an estimate of broker fees or market impact.

Limits: different vendor and rolls, one search repetition, idealized daily execution, no measured impact model.
